sn22.67:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn22.67:1.3: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu …pe… vihareyyanti.
sn22.67:1.4: yaṃ kho bhikkhu dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabboti.
sn22.67:2.1: yathākathaṃ pana tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsīti.
sn22.67:2.2: rūpaṃ kho bhante dukkhaṃ tatra me chando pahātabbo.
sn22.67:2.6: viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ tatra me chando pahātabbo.
sn22.67:2.7: imassa khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavatā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāmīti.
sn22.67:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa vitthārena atthaṃ ājānāsi.
sn22.67:3.3: rūpaṃ kho bhikkhu dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn22.67:3.7: viññāṇaṃ dukkhaṃ tatra te chando pahātabbo.
sn22.67:3.8: imassa kho bhikkhu mayā saṅkhittena bhāsitassa evaṃ vitthārena attho daṭṭhabboti …pe…
sn22.67:3.9: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
